message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters features a central illustration of a figure from the chest up. The figure has a human head and body but wears a glossy, reddish-pink mask resembling a pig’s face over their features. The mask includes pointed ears, a snout with two nostrils, and a single visible eye. The figure is dressed in a brown suit jacket, a white collared shirt, and a red necktie. Their arms are crossed, and a gold-colored watch with a round white face is visible on their left wrist.

To the right, a small object resembling a cracked egg with a white interior and a red yolk floats, trailing a translucent brownish liquid. The background is a textured, mottled orange and yellow. 

At the top, a red banner contains the text "Wawancara Eksklusif Mugabe dan Badawi". Below the central title, white text reads "'Politikus Busuk' Siapa Sudi...". Smaller text includes "EDISI 12-18 Januari 2004", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", a barcode, and "Rp 14.700". Vertical lines run vertically across the entire image.
